purpose: Every test corpus that tester-army e2e cannot execute, named with the command that runs it. The coverage audit fails if a workflow invokes one of these runners that is not listed here, or lists a runner nothing invokes any more — silence is not an exclusion.

entries.reason: Rust unit tests compiled into the desktop binary. e2e can drive the desktop app through its web engine, but it cannot execute `#[test]` functions inside a Rust crate.
entries.note: invoked by a CI job, so the corpus runs — it just does not run through e2e

entries.reason: Go suites exist in the tree and no job runs them. Named here because the plan document previously asserted a separate CI job for them, which does not exist: `grep -rn 'go test' .github/workflows/` returns nothing. This is a real hole in 'every test runs under e2e', not an exclusion.
entries.note: named as a hole, not as an exclusion: `invoked: false` exempts this entry from the 'must still be invoked' check, because the point of listing it is that nothing invokes it

entries.reason: Provider-boundary regressions for the Python agent harnesses. tester-army e2e ships a Node/TypeScript engine plus web/mobile drivers; there is no Python engine, and these suites assert on the Python packages' own imports and mock providers. Migrating them means porting the harness, not re-scheduling it.

entries.reason: The openmuse suites run on Bun inside a submodule checkout, which root e2e cannot collect natively. T01.10 (#522) makes that boundary executable under accounting instead of silent: BA_FOREIGN_SUITE=TaskId selects only fixed cwd/runner/argv targets the whitelist registers per task, and the driver refuses unknown tasks, missing targets, zero tests, skips and failures rather than passing them.
entries.note: invoked: false is the shape of a named channel with no CI entry and no registered target yet: leaf tasks register targets they already own (never pre-registered), and node scripts/e2e-coverage-audit.mjs pins the runner types and names this executor on every run

entries.reason: The bifrost governance suites are Go tests inside the bifrost submodule, driven by root e2e through `go test -json`: the driver parses the child's own report and accepts only verdicts with a positive test count, no skips and no failures. In a checkout where the submodule is not initialized a registered target blocks explicitly (non-zero) instead of passing.
entries.note: the runtime-go/agent-trpc entry above is a different corpus (in-tree Go dirs no job runs); the bifrost corpora reach e2e only through the fixed whitelist this entry names
